import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    dim_store = inputs["dim_store"].copy()
    stg_store_full = inputs["stg_store_full"].copy()
    batch_control = inputs["batch_control"].copy()
    
    # Get batch_date
    batch_date = batch_control["batch_date"].iloc[0]
    
    # Get distinct rows from staging
    stg_distinct = stg_store_full.drop_duplicates(subset=["store_id", "region", "format"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Track which store_ids are in staging
    staged_store_ids = set(stg_distinct["store_id"].unique())
    
    # Start with all non-current rows (they never change)
    result_rows = dim_store[dim_store["is_current"] == 0].copy()
    result_rows = result_rows.reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Process each distinct staged store
    for _, stg_row in stg_distinct.iterrows():
        stg_store_id = stg_row["store_id"]
        stg_region = stg_row["region"]
        stg_format = stg_row["format"]
        
        # Find current row for this store_id
        current_rows = dim_store[
            (dim_store["store_id"] == stg_store_id) & (dim_store["is_current"] == 1)
        ]
        
        if len(current_rows) > 0:
            # Current row exists
            c = current_rows.iloc[0]
            
            # Check if region or format differs (with NULL handling)
            region_differs = False
            format_differs = False
            
            # Compare region
            if pd.isna(c["region"]) and pd.isna(stg_region):
                region_differs = False
            elif pd.isna(c["region"]) or pd.isna(stg_region):
                region_differs = True
            else:
                region_differs = (c["region"] != stg_region)
            
            # Compare format
            if pd.isna(c["format"]) and pd.isna(stg_format):
                format_differs = False
            elif pd.isna(c["format"]) or pd.isna(stg_format):
                format_differs = True
            else:
                format_differs = (c["format"] != stg_format)
            
            if region_differs or format_differs:
                # Close current row
                c_closed = c.copy()
                c_closed["eff_end_date"] = batch_date
                c_closed["is_current"] = 0
                result_rows = pd.concat([result_rows, pd.DataFrame([c_closed])], ignore_index=True)
                
                # Insert new version
                new_row = pd.DataFrame([{
                    "store_id": stg_store_id,
                    "region": stg_region,
                    "format": stg_format,
                    "eff_start_date": batch_date,
                    "eff_end_date": pd.NaT,
                    "is_current": 1
                }])
                result_rows = pd.concat([result_rows, new_row], ignore_index=True)
            else:
                # No changes, keep current row as-is
                result_rows = pd.concat([result_rows, pd.DataFrame([c])], ignore_index=True)
        else:
            # No current row: new store or reactivation
            new_row = pd.DataFrame([{
                "store_id": stg_store_id,
                "region": stg_region,
                "format": stg_format,
                "eff_start_date": batch_date,
                "eff_end_date": pd.NaT,
                "is_current": 1
            }])
            result_rows = pd.concat([result_rows, new_row], ignore_index=True)
    
    # Close current rows whose store_id is NOT in staging
    current_not_staged = dim_store[
        (dim_store["is_current"] == 1) & 
        (~dim_store["store_id"].isin(staged_store_ids))
    ]
    
    for _, row in current_not_staged.iterrows():
        row_closed = row.copy()
        row_closed["eff_end_date"] = batch_date
        row_closed["is_current"] = 0
        result_rows = pd.concat([result_rows, pd.DataFrame([row_closed])], ignore_index=True)
    
    result_rows = result_rows.reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Ensure correct dtypes
    result_rows["store_id"] = result_rows["store_id"].astype("int64")
    result_rows["region"] = result_rows["region"].astype("str")
    result_rows["format"] = result_rows["format"].astype("str")
    result_rows["eff_start_date"] = result_rows["eff_start_date"].astype("datetime64[us]")
    result_rows["eff_end_date"] = result_rows["eff_end_date"].astype("datetime64[us]")
    result_rows["is_current"] = result_rows["is_current"].astype("int64")
    
    return {"dim_store_out": result_rows}
